quote: Utilities Minister Melford Nicholas has confirmed that Antigua and Barbuda is set to receive a US$60 million grant from China to support a national re-piping initiative aimed at modernising the country’s aging water infrastructure. The funding, which was secured following a diplomatic visit by Prime Minister Gaston Browne to China, is expected to accelerate efforts to replace deteriorating underground pipelines
note: Opened Antigua News Room 16 Jun 2025 (USD 60m China re-piping grant; UNVERIFIED).
